title: Argentinian Sun Dried Tomatoes Empanadas
description: A dense and flavorful Argentinian dish featuring sun dried tomatoes, perfect for a crowd, made with macrobiotic friendly ingredients and cooked in a bamboo tray with papillote, giving it a floral and exotic taste

ingredients.name: sun dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: packed in oil, drained and chopped

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped sun dried tomatoes, onion, garlic, salt, and black pepper
Place a tablespoon of the tomato mixture onto the center of each empanada dough circle
Brush the edges of the dough with olive oil and fold the dough in half to form a half moon shape
Press the edges together to seal the empanada
Place the empanadas on a bamboo tray lined with papillote
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and sprinkle with chopped parsley
Bake the empanadas for 25 minutes, or until golden brown
